en.longDescription:
NocoDB turns any SQL database into a spreadsheet-style collaborative database with REST and GraphQL APIs.

Includes PostgreSQL. Set NC_PUBLIC_URL via SERVICE_URL_NOCODB. JWT signing uses SERVICE_HEX_64_NOCODB.

de.longDescription:
NocoDB verwandelt jede SQL-Datenbank in eine tabellenkalkulationsartige kollaborative Datenbank mit REST- und GraphQL-APIs.

Enthält PostgreSQL. Setze NC_PUBLIC_URL über SERVICE_URL_NOCODB. Die JWT-Signierung verwendet SERVICE_HEX_64_NOCODB.

fr.longDescription:
NocoDB transforme toute base SQL en base de données collaborative de type tableur avec des API REST et GraphQL.

Inclut PostgreSQL. Définissez NC_PUBLIC_URL via SERVICE_URL_NOCODB. La signature JWT utilise SERVICE_HEX_64_NOCODB.

pt.longDescription:
NocoDB transforma qualquer banco SQL em um banco de dados colaborativo estilo planilha com APIs REST e GraphQL.

Inclui PostgreSQL. Defina NC_PUBLIC_URL via SERVICE_URL_NOCODB. A assinatura JWT usa SERVICE_HEX_64_NOCODB.
